section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 15, Västland-Marma
section.notes: Naturkartan and Upplandsstiftelsen give 17.5 km. Visit Roslagen gives 16.5 km as secondary Vikingaleden metadata; keep 17.5 km as canonical.

largeGaps.note: Official GPX simplification near Marma; not treated as a missing route section.

interSegmentGaps.note: Honolulukojan spur returns close to the main route. Preserve segments and do not draw a false connector.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan Etapp 15 GPX as primary geometry.
The GPX direction matches official prose: Västland-to-Marma.
Preserve the official multi-segment geometry; Honolulukojan appears as a spur/side segment.
Do not auto-connect segment 1 to segment 2 across the 151 m intersegment gap.
qa: Downloaded GPX has five segments and 295 points; computed distance preserving segment boundaries is about 17.21 km.
The only >500 m intra-segment step is a 514.7 m simplification near Marma.
Etapp 14 endpoint to Etapp 15 start is about 1.5 m; Etapp 15 end to Etapp 16 start is 0 m.

importRows.name: Vindskydd, Västland
importRows.notes: Shelter by Tämnarån near Hembygdsgården, reached by a short signed spur. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 14.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Västland
importRows.notes: Fireplace at the Västland shelter/rest area by Tämnarån. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 14.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Västland
importRows.notes: Rest area at the Västland shelter beside Tämnarån. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 14.

importRows.name: Vatten, Västlands kyrka
importRows.notes: Tap at Västlands kyrka/parish house, to the right of the smaller entrance. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 14.

importRows.name: Toalett, Västlands kyrka
importRows.notes: Public toilet on the church grounds; shared endpoint service with Etapp 14. Listed as year-round but may close for winter repairs.

importRows.name: Raststuga, Honolulukojan
importRows.notes: Open, unbookable rest/overnight cabin near Trusksjön with four beds, stove, table, benches and chairs. Be prepared to share; clean up and pack out rubbish.

importRows.name: Eldplatser, Honolulukojan
importRows.notes: Two outdoor fireplaces with sitting benches at Honolulukojan. Firewood is refilled periodically, but current fire-risk/fire-ban rules still apply.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Honolulukojan
importRows.notes: Rest area around the open hut, same physical cluster as the cabin and fireplaces.

importRows.name: Utedass, Honolulukojan
importRows.notes: Simple dry toilet near Honolulukojan. Toilet paper is refilled periodically, but the official object recommends carrying backup.

importRows.name: Vindskydd, Marma / Dalälven
importRows.notes: Shelter by Dalälven/Marmafjärden a bit before the stage finish, with river/lake view.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Marma / Dalälven
importRows.notes: Fireplace at the Marma/Dalälven shelter cluster.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Marma / Dalälven
importRows.notes: Rest area at the Marma/Dalälven shelter cluster.

importRows.name: Marmabadet
importRows.notes: Endpoint bathing place at Marmafjärden/Dalälven with jetties and changing hut. Dedupe with Etapp 16 endpoint services.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Marmabadet
importRows.notes: Rest-area context at Marmabadet endpoint. Shared with Etapp 16.

importRows.name: Toalett, Marma badplats
importRows.notes: Water toilet at Marma badplats; season is listed as 1 May-30 September on the Etapp 16 toilet/water object. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 16.

importRows.name: Vatten, Marma badplats
importRows.notes: Drinking water at the Marma badplats toilet/water object; listed as open 1 May-30 September. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 16.

pending.name: Tingshällarna
pending.reason: Official route prose describes Tingshällarna as bedrock slabs and stone blocks traditionally said to be a domarring. No discrete Naturkartan/Fornsök coordinate was verified in this pass, so keep pending/context rather than overclaiming.

suppressions.name: Parkering, Västland
suppressions.notes: A few parking spaces at Västlands kyrka. Access metadata only; shared with Etapp 14.

suppressions.name: Busshållplats, Västlands kyrka
suppressions.notes: Start transit metadata only. Shared with Etapp 14.

suppressions.name: Parkering, Marma
suppressions.notes: Parking near Marma kiosk and the Etapp 16 start. Access metadata only; shared with Etapp 16.

suppressions.name: Busshållplats, Marma centrum
suppressions.notes: Endpoint transit metadata only. Official route prose says Marma has bus and train access.

suppressions.name: Tågstation, Marma
suppressions.notes: Train station metadata only. Official distance wording varies between about 200 m and 500 m depending on measured path/route point.

suppressions.name: Honolulukojan has no reliable water
suppressions.notes: Honolulukojan source says to bring your own water and that it is difficult to take water from the lake. Do not import Trusksjön or nearby natural water as a normal water source.

suppressions.name: Trusksjön context
suppressions.notes: Overgrown lake context near Honolulukojan. Suppress as a POI and do not import as water.

suppressions.name: Marma kiosk and store context
suppressions.notes: Route prose mentions kiosk/store in Marma. Suppress for now because current opening hours/stability were not verified.

suppressions.name: Fire-risk and fire-ban context
suppressions.notes: Check current fire-risk/fire-ban guidance before using fireplaces. This is general planning context, not a permanent section-specific closure.

suppressions.name: Marma skjutfält context
suppressions.notes: Supporting sources mention the final stretch near a military exercise/shooting area. Suppress as POI; obey local signs, barriers and current Försvarsmakten notices if present.

suppressions.name: Sätra nature reserve context
suppressions.notes: Nearby reserve context only; no clear route-specific import point was confirmed in this pass. Reserve rules apply if detouring.

suppressions.name: Etapp 14 leakage
suppressions.notes: Suppress Etapp 14-specific rows except shared Västland endpoint services/access. Do not import Lövstabruk, Österlövsta, Svenbo, Barsjön or Etapp 14-only context into Etapp 15.

suppressions.name: Etapp 16 leakage
suppressions.notes: Suppress Etapp 16-specific rows except shared Marma endpoint services/access. Do not import Storfjärden bird tower, Gropholmarna, Ambricka, Lanforsen, Laxön or Älvkarleby into Etapp 15.

decisions.dedupePolicy: Dedupe Västland endpoint services/access with Etapp 14 and Marma endpoint services/access with Etapp 16. Keep transport/parking rows metadata-only. Preserve Honolulukojan as an Etapp 15 spur cluster.

iterationLog.focus: First batch pass for Etapp 15 using official route pages, GPX segment QA, Naturkartan object pages, Upplandsstiftelsen hut details, municipal bathing data, access metadata and leakage review.
iterationLog.result: Created standalone Etapp 15 research file. Normal imports cover shared Västland endpoint services, Honolulukojan cabin/fire/rest/toilet, Marma/Dalälven shelter/fire/rest and shared Marmabadet/toilet/water endpoint services. Tingshällarna remains pending pending a verified coordinate. Parking/transit, no-water caveats, Trusksjön, Marma commercial services, fire-risk/shooting-range/reserve context and Etapp 14/16 leakage are metadata-only or suppressed.

iterationLog.sourceReview: Primary evidence remains the official Naturkartan/Upplandsstiftelsen route material already cited in this file; no new row was promoted solely from unsourced inference.

validation.mapCanDrawCondition: Draw/use the official Naturkartan Etapp 15 GPX as a five-segment geometry. Preserve Honolulukojan spur geometry and do not draw false intersegment connectors.
